surface: Goals overview, goal detail, and exact next-Quest handoff
scope: Rebuild the representative goal journey around the approved desk and archway images so the room itself withdraws, reveals depth, crosses the lit threshold, and arrives before any further Goals expansion
user_job: See the goal that matters now, find a lighter or support route when needed, and enter the exact next Quest without leaving the same authored world

active_sources.judged_state: Goals overview with one active personal goal before pressing Begin
Transition from the selected goal into its detail while the room remains spatially continuous

superseded_sources.reason: The later Goals hard reset in design-qa.md names living commitment as the production direction and supersedes every earlier Goals verdict
It remains historical system evidence but no longer governs the current Goals composition

product.decision: The page centers one personal commitment with the user's reason, one concrete current action, a lighter version, and direct support doors rather than presenting a goal-management dashboard
product.proof: A seeded personal goal keeps its reason and exact next action visible while Unstick Me and Guided Workouts remain directly reachable

interaction.decision: Pressing Begin visibly acknowledges commitment, withdraws the camera from the desk into the full room, crosses the lit archway, and settles inside the goal before detail can hand off to the exact linked Quest
interaction.proof: Finger-down, accepted Opening state, desk withdrawal, full-room threshold, archway crossing, detail arrival, reverse travel, and exact Quest focus form one continuous tested journey

visual.decision: The generated desk and archway compositions become one continuous authored apartment: the desk is the intimate resting place, the wide room is a real held threshold, and the warm kitchen is the visible destination
visual.proof: The source and current 430x932 keyframes retain coherent architecture, perspective, material detail, violet-to-amber light, object-anchored controls, one luminous action, and no banner-over-dashboard split

anti_fallbacks.fallback: A decorative room banner above ordinary stacked dashboard cards
anti_fallbacks.why: It turns the authored environment into wallpaper and lets generic task-management structure own the page

anti_fallbacks.fallback: Multiple glossy or high-contrast action cards competing at once
anti_fallbacks.why: It erases the single commitment hierarchy and makes support routes compete with the action the user came to do

anti_fallbacks.fallback: A static desk poster with only the goal title and action card morphing across a conventional pushed detail screen
anti_fallbacks.why: It preserves labels but does not create the whole-room withdrawal, archway threshold, or destination arrival promised by the approved direction

first_real_slice.scenario: Open Goals with one personal commitment, press Begin, arrive in its detail, and start the exact next linked Quest
first_real_slice.real_inputs: A production-equivalent goal with a saved reason, a due linked Quest, a lighter version, and available support routes
first_real_slice.user_action: Press and release Begin, then activate the exact current action from goal detail
first_real_slice.expected_outcome: The action acknowledges immediately; the desk camera withdraws into the complete room, holds the lit archway as a readable threshold, crosses into the kitchen-side goal detail, and then focuses the linked Quest rather than a generic destination
first_real_slice.state_boundary: The accepted press rejects rapid re-entry, route completion is awaited, and the exact Quest identity survives the handoff

required_states.state: Goals resting frame before any touch
required_states.why_can_disprove: The room can still collapse into a banner or let supporting actions compete even when navigation works
A tappable control can still feel flat, late, or detached from the commitment it triggers

required_states.state: Desk withdrawal, full-room archway threshold, crossing, and kitchen-side goal-detail arrival
required_states.why_can_disprove: Beautiful endpoints can still feel like a wallpaper zoom, crossfade, or unrelated templates if the room never becomes a continuous place

required_states.state: The same journey with Reduced Motion enabled
required_states.why_can_disprove: Removing travel can accidentally remove spatial continuity or visible acknowledgement altogether

ripple_map.state: Active, empty, hard-day, and dense-scrolled goal states
ripple_map.expected_effect: One commitment remains primary while real support and alternate states stay useful and quiet
ripple_map.verification_plan: Inspect fresh normalized phone renders and use every visible entry point

ripple_map.surface_or_primitive: Goal detail route and back affordance
ripple_map.state: Midpoint, arrival, return, and rapid repeat
ripple_map.expected_effect: The room and goal identity remain continuous while route ownership stays correct
ripple_map.verification_plan: Capture midpoint and arrival and run route, re-entry, and return interaction checks

ripple_map.state: Linked due Quest with legacy title casing and reordered list
ripple_map.expected_effect: The requested Quest, not merely the Quests tab, receives local arrival priority
ripple_map.verification_plan: Run the exact-focus behavior test and inspect the destination state

ripple_map.surface_or_primitive: Lighter version, Unstick Me, and Guided Workouts
ripple_map.expected_effect: Support stays directly discoverable without becoming a second primary hierarchy
ripple_map.verification_plan: Use each door from the overview and inspect both disclosure states

ripple_map.surface_or_primitive: Goals world and live content reflow
ripple_map.state: 320x568 with 1.5x text and long personal content
ripple_map.expected_effect: The core action and support remain reachable without shrinking the authored room into decorative residue
ripple_map.verification_plan: Inspect the narrow large-text render at intended size and activate the primary path

unverified_property: Whether the complete commitment-to-Quest journey feels like physically moving from the desk through the room and into the lit destination while remaining immediate and authored under a person's thumb on the physical phone

decisive_check.method: Use the representative journey on the physical iPhone in normal and Low Power Mode
decisive_check.target: Cold Goals entry, finger-down Begin, desk withdrawal, held wide-room threshold, archway crossing, detail action, exact Quest arrival, reverse return, and rapid repeat
decisive_check.pass_condition: Acknowledgement begins under the finger, the apartment reads as one continuous place with no visible scene seam or generic template frame, the exact Quest arrives, and frame pacing, haptics, and timing feel deliberate rather than late
